title: Geologic Map of the Alvin Quadrangle, Berkeley and Willamsburg Counties, South Carolina
citation: Doar, W.R., III, Willoughby, R.H., and Clendenin, C.W., 2010, Geologic Map of the Alvin Quadrangle, Berkeley and Willamsburg Counties, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-179, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Single OCR'd map sheet; map face is OCR noise. Map symbols me, Qsh, Qcb, QPpt, QPtmh, QPld read from the legend boxes on page-image tiles (OCR prints 'OPld'). OCR misread 'Thickness | to 40 feet' read as 1 (inferred, unclear in OCR). Sections A-A' and B-B' read from page-image tiles: hole labels; for holes whose top sits on the profile, land surface and contact elevations read off the section's own feet scale (inferred, about +/-2 ft). Holes 8-298, 8-295, 8-263, 8-266, 8-293 (B-B'), 8-291, 8-305 (B-B') recorded by label only (tops drawn off the profile or contacts too small to read). Section-only units (QPph, QPw, QPwmud, QPldm, QPfluvial sand, Twh, Twb, QHe) are not described on the sheet. Contact and drill-hole symbols are legend-only. SUBSURFACE: none beyond the recorded values.
